notes: Profile: mid-market contact center SaaS (multi-tenant) focusing on omnichannel support for retail brands.
Primary ask: real-time agent assist that streams short, incremental suggestions into agent UI (Zendesk + proprietary web UI) with strict latency SLOs under bursty traffic.
Peak scale: ~250 concurrent agents typical, spike tests up to 2k concurrent during flash sales windows.
Latency target: end-to-end suggestion appear <200ms 95th pct; suggestion completion for a multi-turn prompt <800ms; first-token streaming <120ms preferred.
Throughput profile: lots of short sessions (1-3 turn lookups) plus periodic longer summarization jobs at EOD.
Tooling: must support function/tool-calling to trigger CRM updates, create tickets, and fetch account context from internal API. Need structured output (JSON) with strict schema and validation.
Guardrails: hallucination mitigation required; deterministic citation for quotes when summarizing; ability to attach confidence score and human-in-the-loop flag.
Cost sensitivity: wants Optimize recommendations to balance batching and latency — highest value is preserving agent-per-minute efficiency while keeping cloud costs predictable.
Security: SSO/SAML already in place; legal asked for SOC2 or ISO27001 evidence and a short audit trail sample (redact PII) for reviews.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-25): "We can accept small loss in quality for tooling calls but cannot have hallucinated ticket updates. Every write must be confirmed or reversible."
